title: Disraeli Gears
notes:
This release contains the stamped/laser-etched "MPO logo®" and following numbers that enable determination of pressing year. The release which has a hand-etched "MPO" without stamped/laser-etched logo or following numbers is here: [r7010186]. Both releases contain identical artwork.

Includes a voucher to download an MP3 version of the album.

On the release track B4 is credited to [a17827], but was originally written by [a707252].
